request.description:
**POST /studentHallTicket/generate**

**One-time only:** if any hall ticket already exists for that exam setup term + session (same institute/university), returns **400** — regeneration is not allowed.

Otherwise **creates** one row per eligible student (new QR each). **Requires at least one** `exam_schedule` row for that pair with **both** `examDate` and `examTime` (one scheduled subject is enough for Mid-term / End-sem, etc.).

**Body** uses folder vars `hallticket_examSetupTypeTermId`, `hallticket_sessionId`.

**GET /studentHallTicket**

Optional filters: **`examSetupTypeTermId`**, **`sessionId`**, **`studentId`** (folder vars). **Pagination:** **`page`** (default 1), **`limit`** (default **1000** if omitted; each request clamps **`limit`** to **10–1000**). Response **`data`** is the current page of hall tickets; **`paginationData`** has **`total`**, **`page`**, **`limit`**, **`totalPages`** (same pattern as GET `/questionPaper`).

**GET /studentHallTicket/:id**

Path id = `hallticket_hallTicketId`. Top level: student/session/exam-type fields; **`subjects`** lists every `exam_schedule` for this ticket’s term + session. Each item has flat fields (`subjectId`, `subjectName`, …) plus nested **`subject`** (full subject row: type, term, course, etc.) and **`semester`** when linked.

item.name: bulk upload
item.description:
**POST /libraryCreation/bulkUpload?libraryCreationId=**

Upload an Excel file (`.xlsx`). Each row = one inventory copy.

**Query**
| Key | Required |
|-----|----------|
| `libraryCreationId` | Yes |

**Body (form-data)**
| Key | Type | Required |
|-----|------|----------|
| `book` | file | Yes |

**Required Excel columns (every row)**
`isbn`, `excisionNumber`, `Aisle`, `Rack`, `Row`

**Required only when ISBN is new in DB**
`title`, `authors`

**Optional book columns**
`publisher`, `keywords`, `subtitle`, `barcode`, `itemType`, …

**Logic**
- ISBN exists → inventory row only
- ISBN new → book + inventory
- Same ISBN twice in file → first row creates book, next rows inventory only

**Success**
```json
{ "success": true, "message": "Data uploaded successfully" }
```

**Error**
```json
{ "message": "Row 2: Rack is required" }
```

formdata.description: Excel file — columns: title, authors, isbn, excisionNumber, Aisle, Rack, Row, publisher, keywords

item.name: fee v2
item.description:
## End-to-end flow (run in order)

1. **feeTypeCategory** — CRUD fee categories
2. **feeTypeCatalog** — CRUD catalog lines
3. **feePlanProfile** — create plan; **GET /summary**; **GET /all?status=**; **PATCH /assignStudent** (link plan to student)
4. **student (fee v2)** — **GET /student/feePlanProfiles/all**; **GET /student/all**; **GET /student?studentId=**; **POST /student**; **PATCH /feePlanProfile/assignStudent** (assign plan); dropdown **GET /options/feePlans**
5. **studentFeeInvoice** — term: **POST /** ; adhoc: **POST /additional** (feeTypeCatalogs[], waiver); list: **GET /all?status=** (all|pending|completed); **GET ?studentId=** (student + invoices)
6. **studentFeePayment** — record payment

## Removed
- GET /feePlanProfile/lookup — use **GET /options/feePlans**
- GET /student/:id/feeDetails — use **GET /studentFeeInvoice?studentId=**

## Tables (v2)
fee_type_categories, fee_type_catalog, fee_plan_profile, fee_plan_item, additional_fee, students.fee_plan_profile_id, student_fee_invoice, student_invoice_additional_fee, student_fee_payment

item.name: feePlanProfile
item.description: Fee plans v2. **PATCH /assignStudent** — set students.fee_plan_profile_id (body: studentId, feePlanProfileId). **GET /summary**, **GET /all?status=**, **GET /** by courseSessionId, **GET /single**. Dropdown: **GET /options/feePlans**.

request.description:
Creates fee_plan_profile + feePlanItems (terms) + optional feeTypeCatalogs[] per installment.

Each feeTypeCatalogs[] entry: feeTypeCatalogId + amount (stored on additional_fee).

planType: annual | semester | trimester (lowercase). academicYearId optional.

**GET /feePlanProfile/summary** — dashboard cards on Fees Invoice page.

- **activeFeePlans**: fee_plan_profile assigned to ≥1 student (students.fee_plan_profile_id)
- **inactiveFeePlans**: profiles not assigned to any student
- **allFeePlans**: total profiles for institute

**GET /feePlanProfile/all?status=**

- **all** — every fee plan for institute
- **active** — assigned to ≥1 student (students.fee_plan_profile_id)
- **inactive** — no student assigned

**data:** { status, feePlans[] }
Fee plans with ≥1 student assigned. Response: { status: "active", feePlans[] }.
Fee plans with zero students assigned. Response: { status: "inactive", feePlans[] }.

Query: courseSessionId (required). Response data: { courseSessionId, feePlans[] } — each plan: numberOfInvoices (term invoices via fee_plan_item), feePlanItems[{ feePlanItemId, termName, numberOfInvoices }], assignedStudentCount, status, termFees, totalFees, etc.

**GET /feePlanProfile/single?feePlanProfileId=**

Formatted detail (no raw timestamps on nested catalog).

**Profile:** planName, planType, courseSessionId, **courseName**, **sessionName**, courseId, sessionId, assignedStudentCount, numberOfInvoices, status (active|inactive), term, termFees, additionalFees, totalFees.

**feePlanItems[]:** feePlanItemId, termName, createDate, dueDate, amount, additionalFees, total, numberOfInvoices, itemAdditionalFees[{ name, amount, feeTypeCatalogId }].

**PATCH /feePlanProfile/assignStudent**

Assigns fee v2 plan to a student (updates `students.fee_plan_profile_id` only).

**Body (required):** `studentId`, `feePlanProfileId`.

**200 data:** studentId, feePlanProfileId, studentName, scholarNumber, feePlanName, planType.

Use instead of **PATCH /student/:id** when you only need to link a plan (no semesterId / full student form).

Run after **create** plan and **student** exists (`student_id`, `feePlanProfile_id` vars).

item.name: studentFeeInvoice
item.description: Invoices v2. Term: POST / with feePlanItemId. Adhoc: POST /additional with feeTypeCatalogs[] (+ optional waiver). List institute: GET /all?status=all|pending|completed. By student: GET /?studentId= returns { student, invoices[] }. Detail: GET /single.

request.description:
**POST /studentFeeInvoice** — term / fee-plan invoice.

Body: studentId, feePlanItemId only. instituteId from auth.

Creates student_fee_invoice (linked to fee_plan_item) + student_invoice_additional_fee rows from plan additional_fee lines.

201 message: "Invoice generated". data: studentFeeInvoiceId, amount, total, totalVerified, additionalFees[], feePlanItem, student (if loaded).

**POST /studentFeeInvoice/additional** — adhoc invoice (misconduct, fine, etc.). No feePlanItemId.

**Body (required):** studentId, feeTypeCatalogs[] (min 1), createDate (YYYY-MM-DD).

**feeTypeCatalogs[] each line:** feeTypeCatalogId, amount; optional waiver (≥ 0, cannot exceed amount).

**Invoice total** = sum of (amount − waiver) per line. Example: 5000−500 + 3000−500 = **7000** (not 8000 gross).

**Optional:** dueDate (null allowed), total — if sent, must equal net sum after waivers; omit total to auto-compute.

**Stored:** student_invoice_additional_fee.amount (gross), .waiver; student_fee_invoice.amount = total (net).

instituteId from auth.

201 data (minimal): studentFeeInvoiceId, studentId, total, createDate, dueDate, paymentStatus. Use GET /studentFeeInvoice/single for full detail.

**GET /studentFeeInvoice/all?status=**

- **all** — every generated invoice
- **pending** — unpaid + partial
- **completed** — paid

**data:** { status, invoices[] } — studentFeeInvoiceId, studentName, scholarNumber, amount, paid, balanceDue, paymentStatus, termName, createDate, dueDate.
Unpaid and partial invoices only. Same response shape as status=all.
Paid invoices only. Same response shape as status=all.

**GET /studentFeeInvoice?studentId=** — v2 replacement for GET /student/:id/feeDetails.

**data:** { student: { studentId, studentName, scholarNumber }, invoices[] } — each invoice: studentFeeInvoiceId, termName, total, paymentStatus, totalPaid, balanceDue, additionalFees[{ name, amount }].

**GET /studentFeeInvoice/single?studentFeeInvoiceId=**

Full invoice detail. data includes:
- studentFeeInvoiceId, studentId, feePlanItemId, instituteId
- **student** — studentId, firstName, middleName, lastName, studentName, scholarNumber, email, mobileNumber, enrollNumber, feePlanProfileId
- amount, additionalFeesTotal, total, storedTotal, totalVerified
- createDate, dueDate, status, paymentStatus, totalPaid, balanceDue
- feePlanItem (term; null fields for adhoc)
- additionalFees[] — name, description, amount, netAmount per catalog line
Body: studentFeeInvoiceId, paidAmount, paymentDate, paymentMethod; optional referenceNumber, notes. data.payment + data.invoice (updated paymentStatus, totalPaid, balanceDue).

**GET /studentFeePayment?studentFeeInvoiceId=**

**data:** studentFeeInvoiceId, **student** { studentId, studentName, scholarNumber, courseId, courseName, sessionId, sessionName }, invoiceTotal, totalPaid, balanceDue, paymentStatus, payments[].

item.name: student (fee v2)
item.description: Fee v2 student APIs: **GET /student/feePlanProfiles/all** → **GET /student/all** → **GET /student?studentId=** → **POST /student** (create) → **PATCH /feePlanProfile/assignStudent** (assign plan; preferred) → optional **PATCH /student/:studentId** (full edit). Then **studentFeeInvoice** per term.

request.description:
**GET /student/feePlanProfiles/all**

Query: `page` (default 1), `limit` (default 20, max 100).

**Response:**
- `data.students[]` — studentId, studentName, scholarNumber, className, program, session, feePlanName, feePlanProfileId, `terms[]`
- `paginationData` — page, limit, total, totalPages

Test script sets `student_id`, `feePlanProfile_id`, `feePlanItem_id` from first row.

Generate invoice: POST /studentFeeInvoice { studentId, feePlanItemId } when canGenerateInvoice is true.

response.name: 200 OK — example

request.description:
**GET /student/all**

Query: `search` (default `all`), `acedmicYearId`, `page` (default 1), `limit` (default 10).

Uses auth `universityId` + `defaultInstituteId`.

Test script sets `student_id` from first row when present.

**GET /student?studentId=**

Returns full student record (addresses, entrance, course, session, **feePlanProfileId**, etc.) for the authenticated university.

404 if not found. Sets `student_id` and `feePlanProfile_id` when present.

**POST /student** — fee v2 create.

**Required (validated):** feePlanProfileId, universityId, campusId, instituteId, affiliatedUniversityId, courseLevelId, courseId, classSectionsId, acedmicYearId, email, firstName, fatherName, phoneNumber, birthDate.

**roleId:** must be `"STUDENT"` (defaults to STUDENT if omitted); resolved to DB role_id for user permissions.

**Model field names (not aliases):** `admisssionDate` (3× s), `placeOfBirth` (not birthPlace/admissionDate). Entrance: `entranceExam`, `rollNumber`, `categoryRank`, `marks`.

Run **1 fee plan profiles all** first. Then **studentFeeInvoice → generate** per term.

**PATCH /student/:studentId**

`studentId` is the **path** param (`{{student_id}}`), not the body.

**Required in body:** universityId, campusId, instituteId, affiliatedUniversityId, courseLevelId, courseId.

**Optional:** feePlanProfileId (assign/change fee v2 plan), names, contact fields, addressDetails, entranceDetails, files (multipart if used).

Use after **3 get single** or **4 create** so `student_id` is set.
